answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 11423 Country: United States of America Title: As salam amailum my wife she bought ear ring which has stones neelam. she want to confirm, with somebody before wearing. those it is related to stars. please let me know. Jazakallah kahir Question: As salam amailum my wife she bought ear ring which has stones neelam. she want to confirm, with somebody before wearing. those it is related to stars. please let me know. Jazakallah kahir Answer ID: 11423 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 378/351=B/1430) The neelam stones embedded in earring are not related to stars, they are only for adornment. Your wife can wear those earrings, there is no wrong whatsoever. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
